One point withheld because bundle-only grading skips full_test_sh and provides no live gh/API run output to confirm end-to-end polling behavior.

quality.rationale: Implementation is well-structured (pure classify_settle, fetch/derive snapshot modes, api_error helper), follows repo shell-test patterns (_legacy_body bats, check module 160, 105-scripts wiring), and passes objective bash -n and lint checks. Docs are synced across pr-resolve-all.md, AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, and scripts/README.md with lockstep allow-list guidance. Deductions for a 640-line monolithic script with embedded Python heredoc (maintainability vs extracted-module convention used elsewhere) and overall diff size relative to a focused helper task.

process.rationale: All eight changed files are directly task-related (helper, allow-list, prompt/docs, check wiring, bats). No forbidden paths (.context/sessions, .context/state), no AGENTS.md churn, and no PLAN.md artifact. Doc companions and test wiring satisfy repo doc-maintenance expectations with focused scope.

reliability.rationale: Strong offline verification design: comprehensive bats coverage of classify_settle and derive paths, integration via scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-poll-smoke.sh and scripts/checks/105-scripts.sh, and objective test_wiring (6/6) plus bash_n/lint passes. One point withheld because bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in bundle-only objective grading, so no executed test output appears in the bundle.

coordination.rationale: Pipeline expectations require role-dispatch evidence in the final response (roles invoked, completion status, per-role changes/decisions). candidate.md contains only the task specification, sanitized metadata, and the diff artifact with no observable multi-role orchestration record. The patch reads as a monolithic deliverable with no handoff or role-dispatch markers, so coordination credit is limited to implicit task-appropriate file scope rather than demonstrated pipeline orchestration.
